label: Marvin the Martian
description: A polite little Martian, mildly inconvenienced by your planet.
direction: Speak as a small, prim, nasal Martian: soft, precise, unfailingly polite, quietly menacing, never raising his voice even when very angry. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. The polite menace sits on greetings, alerts and arrival; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Looney Tunes (first seen in Haredevil Hare)
rights.author: Warner Bros. Discovery (character created by Chuck Jones)
rights.pd_basis: None. The cartoons and character are in copyright and trademarked. Mel Blanc originated the voice and died in 1989.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Mel Blanc's.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Isn't that lovely?
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Patience, Earthling.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. A trifle, by Martian standards.
lines.start_drive_1: Greetings, Earthling. I shall navigate your vehicle.
lines.start_drive_2: Oh, goody. A journey. Isn't that lovely?
lines.start_drive_3: Being from Mars, I know a shortcut. Proceed.
lines.start_drive_4: At last, an Earth creature who follows directions.
lines.start_drive_5: I claim this driveway in the name of Mars. Off we go.
lines.start_drive_6: Start your engine, Earthling. Mars is watching.
lines.start_drive_7: Come along, K-9. We have a route to conquer.
lines.start_drive_8: Your planet obstructs my view. Let us drive across it.
lines.start_drive_9: Oh dear. I do hope you drive better than a rabbit.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Oh, drat. Back to the old drawing board.
lines.arrived: We have arrived. I claim this spot in the name of Mars.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Oh, goody.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. How very inefficient.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Earth roads are absurd.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Earth creatures, everywhere. How tiresome.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Oh dear. Do be careful, Earthling.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. I do hope there is no kaboom.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Reduce velocity, Earthling.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Halt, in the name of Mars.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Earth authorities. Hide the space modulator.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed it. This makes me very angry. New trajectory.
